name: The Shadow Team
description: A team of elite agents within Turkey's National Intelligence Organisation are recruited for covert operations — on the condition that the outside world believes they are dead. Led by veteran officer Mete Bey, the shadow team carries out high-stakes missions at home and abroad, battling terrorist networks and foreign threats to national security. Drawn from real events, it's Turkey's answer to the spy thriller genre — patriotic, action-packed and relentlessly tense.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A dark structure acting against Turkey targets Turkey's UAV and SIHA program, which attracts international attention by commissioning its plans. After this surprise move, a decision is made to create a secret team under the umbrella of the National Intelligence Agency. While this team, led by experienced intelligence officer Mete Bey, is planned to carry out many covert operations at home and abroad, it is necessary that the team members are officially dead. Mete Bey meets with Zehra, Uncle Hakkı, Pınar, Hulki, Uzay and Georgan one by one and tells each of them that everyone who knows them and their families should consider them dead. For the leadership of this team, which brings together the best intelligence officers of the organization, the most popular name of the organization is Serdar Kılıçaslan. While Serdar remains between his love for homeland and his love for Ceren, the other members of the team realize that they will go on an irreversible path.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Serdar, who suffers from the biggest shock of his life due to his beloved Ceren being a traitor, is questioned by internal affairs while thinking about how he came to this game. After the plane crash, with the official announcement of the death of the members of the team, the families go to Mete's side. While Mete gives the bitter news to families, team members who cannot communicate with their families. Serdar, who came out of the internal affairs inquiry, has to continue his relationship with Ceren on the instructions of Mete. While the team works hard to track down Pascal, who organized the SİHA attack, Serdar, who came to the secret headquarters, meets the team members. Upon the information that Pascal will flee abroad, the team takes action for their first operation. Vowing not to leave the blood of the martyred engineers on the ground, the team is determined to catch Pascal and reach the dark structure behind him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Serdar still has difficulty believing in the love game he is drawn into. On the other hand, he wants to take back the external disk containing the SİHA protocols, which were seized by the killing of the country's pupil engineers, as soon as possible. Serdar sets a deadly trap by getting help from Zehra. Although it irritates Zehra, the trap works, and the war between Ceren and Serdar is getting hot! Those who died before they die, on the one hand, try to cope with the fact that they are unable to reach out to them by following their families' experiences in the face of their loss from a distance. But, on the other hand, in this game, in which they risk everything with their love of their homeland, they are now pursuing those who order an attack on the SİHA factory. An established game opens the door to reaching the “company”, which instructs Pascal to attack. This door leads our heroes first to Berlin, then to a bargaining table in Berlin, where there are enemies from many countries.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zayed Fadi, whose plans were disrupted by the team's operation, wants revenge. Fadi's putting Serdar at the top of the list of those who will be destroyed! He's mobilizing his men to see if Serdar has left Berlin. Serdar convinces Fadi and his men that he has left Berlin. With the intelligence it has obtained, the team is moving to prevent Fadi's provocations. The fact that Serdar and the team did not leave Berlin and disrupted all the plans puts Ceren in a difficult position. Ceren now has to prove himself again to Fadi. Neo-Nazi groups are attacking expatriate Turks in Berlin with the support of Fadi's men. The team is setting up a dangerous game to prevent these attacks. Serdar infiltrates neo-Nazis under a different identity. Serdar is under the influence of past traumas in this difficult task. Trying to prevent provocations against expatriate Turks, the team is plunged into an international crisis.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Nevzat's desire to take Sinan and leave Temrenli upset Mavi Ay. After the archery match, Sinan disappeared. Iskender promises his friends that he will bring Sinan back. Kasirga, on the other hand, is busy bragging to everyone everywhere with the joy of winning the archery match. Refika finds a copy paper in the classroom and moves to determine who cheated on the Turkish exam. Elif confesses to Refika that she is the cheater and confronts the disciplinary board to face her punishment. Iskender, on the other hand, finds Sinan's place thanks to his super skills, but bringing Sinan back will not be as easy as he thinks. Sinan's father, Nevzat, is determined to leave Temrenli to protect his son from him. What will Kasirga say about their win live on air? How will Iskender find Sinan, who has disappeared? What awaits Elif, who confesses to cheating? Will Sinan leave Temrenli? Will Iskender be able to convince Nevzat to bring Sinan back?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ceren, who was surprised by Serdar's announcement of his identity and proposing to her, doesn't know what to do about this surprise move. A mysterious name from her past helps Ceren, who is confused by this movement that reaches the end of the road... Zayed Fadi is cornered when the team takes over Leyal, his most trusted member. He is forced to accept the offer to trade Hulki and Leyal. The team sets out to be extraordinarily prepared in planning each step to ensure the exchange takes place safely. Pınar and Hakkı left for the determined region of northern Iraq for exploration. Serdar and Zehra, who brought Leyal to the area where the exchange will take place, face unexpected surprises along the way. Fadi also makes his own plans for bartering. Collaborating with terrorist groups in the region, Fadi devises a diabolical plan that will turn everything into a bloodbath after saving Leyal. As the team tries to get Hulki out of the trap, they come across a much bigger threat.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Serdar, Zahra and Hulki, who put their lives on the line by surrendering to prevent the terrorists' treacherous plans, face death. Pınar and Hakkı, who are journalists in front of the terrorists in the region, also come there. Fadi's happiness doesn't last long, considering he's neutralized the SİHA that he's deciphered security protocols. Fadi, who understands the team's game and is surprised by what happened to him, will be in danger of losing his position! Disrupting Fadi's plans, the team returns to the country to rush Hulki, whose condition is getting worse, to the hospital. Fadi's failure causes a great deal of discomfort at the Company. Cornered by the Company's decision, Fadi takes one last chance to prove himself. Suspected of loyalty, Ceren receives instructions from the Chief to kill Serdar. Meanwhile, a video circulated online causes a stir. The teams is on high alert against a planned assassination plot against a senior government official in Ankara.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mete, who was hit by a drone strike, is taken to hospital by the President. While Mete is undergoing emergency surgery, Serdar, who, despite his best efforts, could not prevent the assassination, is shocked by the incident. Although the team managed to escape the ambush set up by Fadi, Mete was shaken by the news of the attack on the President. The team meets at headquarters and rolls up their sleeves to avenge Mete. Despite every attempt to reach Fadi, the perpetrator of the attack on Mete, Fadi has disappeared. Finally, a clue is found with space's superior effort. Fadi's nephew, Kasım Firawi, is scheduled to reach Fadiye. But there is a big problem, Kasım is being held in an Israeli prison. Unable to find another way to get to Fadi, the team sets up a clever game to capture Kasım. Upon learning that Turkish intelligence is after his nephew Kasım, Fadi mobilizes all his means to prevent it.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Serdar, who prevented the planned attack on the MIT building by plane, has disappeared since that day. Searching for Serdar everywhere in the intervening period, the team finally stumbles upon the traces of their lost friends in Poland and takes action. An unexpected person comes to the aid of Serdar, who is in a difficult situation, but Serdar has a big problem that will affect everyone deeply. On the other hand, the team has a new person to meet: President Halit. After Fadi's death, the company chooses a new name for the 6th Region, which includes Turkey. This ...

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Season Finale.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Ömer's only goal, considered dead by his family and loved ones, is to find Zehra. His efforts in this process introduce him to both his new enemies and Neslihan, who will bring him back to the organization. Neslihan's only goal is to keep her promises despite her losses and not leave the people who need her alone. However, even he is not aware of the dangers he will face. The biggest point that unites these two, even indirectly, is the love of the homeland and the desire to protect it. A new team fighting for the same goal will help them on this path. In this tough war, enemies are more dangerous than before. Although new beginnings, new goals and acquaintances lead the heroes to new surprises in the new season of Teşkilat, the only thing that does not change is the love of the homeland.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: With the incident on the Mostar bridge, the enemy took action to create even more confusion. Milorad will target Ömer. Ömer, who puts his pain aside and fights for his homeland, will not remain silent to this challenge. Even though Ömer insists on going his own way, Neslihan's aim is to solve the problem at the table. Knowing that the slightest impulsiveness will cause greater chaos, Neslihan is determined to defend her country with evidence to the world. Gökhan, who has become the target of Ömer's suspicions, is frightened by Neslihan's determination, but will do his best to achieve his goal without giving himself away. The team does not leave Ömer and Neslihan alone in their fight from two different branches. Realizing that they have a lot to learn from each other even though they have just met, the team will be the reliable support of both their homeland and Ömer and Neslihan.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Although Neslihan's arrival at the invitation drags the team into unexpected situations and emotions, Ömer keeps everything under control with his professionalism. Because of his sister, Cihangir is the person who has the most difficulty in this situation among the team. But both he and the other members of the team will learn to control their emotions on the field under Ömer's leadership. While Gökhan tries to confront Neslihan with Milorad, he also maintains his considerate attitude towards Neslihan. Ömer, who does not fall for Gökhan's games, is trying to prove his true identity first to Neslihan and then to the whole world, no matter what. Trusting Ömer's knowledge and foresight, the team will do their best to successfully complete the operation, capture Milorad, and learn the true identity of Horus, despite the sudden surprises they encounter.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: The house the team infiltrated is ready to explode on Horus' command. Even though Gökhan's treacherous plan is for this explosion to happen from Neslihan's hand, Ömer realizes that there will be an explosion with a phone call. While Ömer has to fight alone inside, the rest of the team is waiting for a sign from him outside. Trying to access documents related to both Gökhan and the company, Ömer and the team duke it out with the enemies at the farmhouse. Even though Ömer is sure that Gökhan is Horus, Gökhan continues to confuse Neslihan. Under Ömer's leadership, the team always tries to be one step ahead of Horus and therefore the Company. While they find new clues on this path, they also encounter new enemies. The enemy's target this time will bring Ömer face to face with the past once again.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Although Gökhan, who uses Zehra and her pain, is sure that Ömer will make mistakes, Ömer will not sacrifice Zehra to these games no matter what. Faced with an unexpected move, the team is cautious to prevent innocent people from being harmed. Neslihan makes the biggest promise possible to both the minister and everyone else. Unwanted consequences may cost both Zehra's life and Neslihan's career. While there is a great struggle against time, Neslihan has full confidence in the team and Ömer. Ömer will not lose Zehra this time.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Gökhan is sure that he will get away with what he did. But the team is always one step ahead of Ömer with his plan. Neslihan constantly comes across her father's name on matters related to the company. The new fact he learned is that Çetin is the clear target of the company. Scarlett, who is no longer in Gökhan's shadow, will not hesitate to make moves to eliminate Neslihan and her relatives. Ömer aims to bring Gökhan to Turkey and punish him before he causes a crisis abroad. The team that follows his instructions to the letter is always prepared for any problems that may arise. Both Gökhan and the company will always find Ömer and his team in front of them.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Even though Gökhan disappears, Ömer is aware that this is not the end. The team's new goal is to prevent the company's money transfer and at the same time identify their new enemies. Defeated, Skarlet turns to those closest to her for support. As he enters Neslihan's life without being exposed, his partner will clearly become Ömer's target. New enemies, smarter and more ruthless than before, are aware that they are facing Ömer Atmaca and his team. No matter how much the company's new cell tries to hide itself and obfuscate, the Agency will find them.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Ömer tries to come to the aid of the team trapped by Anton's treacherous plan. The enemy tries to put the team, which is already in danger, in an even more difficult situation. However, what they forget is that the person before them is Ömer Atmaca. While Ömer dukes it out with Anton on the field, Skarlet tries to stay close to Neslihan by using Çetin. Even though the company is sure of the perfection of its plans, Ömer and his team will disrupt the game set by the enemies. Even if they have to sacrifice themselves or each other on this path...

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Despite Cihangir being kidnapped, Ömer and the team do not submit to Anton. Neslihan is shattered by what Skarlet tells her. He confronts his father to learn the truth about his mother. Çetin is now backed into a corner. The target of Çetin's accusations is Ömer. Ömer does his best to both save Cihangir and reach Isis. The team tries to achieve Ömer's plan perfectly. Even though Anton and Skarlet think they have won, they will unknowingly find themselves in the game set by Ömer.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Anton falls into a trap with Ömer's unexpected move. Unable to risk losing his son, Çetin intervenes in his own way to save Cihangir. But thanks to Ömer's attention, he realizes that he cannot hide. Ömer's aim, who has planned everything meticulously from the beginning, is to both save Cihangir and deal a big blow to the enemy. No matter what, he will not bow to the enemy on this path. Neslihan and the team trust Ömer with both their homeland and their lives. That's why they take all risks to complete the operation successfully.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Ömer goes after the mercenaries who came to save Cihangir. His goal is to find out who sent them. Realizing that Ömer will not let this matter go, Çetin is cornered. Cihangir, who burns with the fire of revenge because of his mother, finds Ömer in front of him. Ömer tries to prevent him from making irreversible mistakes. The team tracks down Anton, who lost both his brother and the company's money. Ömer is aware that Anton will make much more brutal moves.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Anton falls into a trap with Ömer's unexpected move. Unable to risk losing his son, Çetin intervenes in his own way to save Cihangir. But thanks to Ömer's attention, he realizes that he cannot hide. Ömer's aim, who has planned everything meticulously from the beginning, is to both save Cihangir and deal a big blow to the enemy. No matter what, he will not bow to the enemy on this path. Neslihan and the team trust Ömer with both their homeland and their lives. That's why they take all risks to complete the operation successfully.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Ömer, devastated by Cihangir's death, challenges Anton, knowing that he will be set up. Ömer swears that he will take revenge on Anton and everyone who martyred Cihangir. Neslihan and the team, devastated by Cihangir's kidnapping, follow the clues left behind. They are sure that these clues will lead them to Cihangir and therefore to Ömer. The team, which does its best to find Ömer and Cihangir, is devastated by the message from Anton. Nothing will ever be the same again. The fire of revenge in Ömer's eyes will burn everyone in front of him.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Ömer, who has one last target for Cihangir's revenge, takes action with the team to capture the Captain he is after. Having lost her brother, Neslihan does not want anyone to be harmed further. Ömer, on the other hand, is determined to catch his enemy. The two face each other again for their goals. Çetin, shaken by the pain of losing a child, takes new steps. Çetin, who blames Ömer for Cihangir's death, confronts Ömer. Ömer and his team, who are aware of the game played on them, do not give up until the criminals are punished. Neither Ömer nor the team will bow to the company's plans.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Omar comes face to face with a new enemy. However, he realizes that this enemy is much different and, most importantly, more dangerous. Neslihan, who is completely cut off from Omer, tries her best to make both Omer and the team safe and sound. Omer will not give up until he gets his revenge no matter what. Even if he loses his life on this path, he will not bow down to the enemy.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Captain Altay comes to give the enemy a hard time. Despite the losses she has suffered, Neslihan stands tall on her duty and fights for her country without blinking. Korkut, on the other hand, completely breaks away from his old life and finds himself in the clutches of danger. The crossing of paths of Neslihan and Captain Altay, who come face to face with great tests, marks the beginning of a new era.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Hearing the possibility that his sister is alive, Altay gets angry and threatens Makinist to find out what he knows about his sister. Neslihan, who thinks that Makinist's conversations are a game, is worried. She realizes what Altay is capable of when it comes to her brother. This situation brings Neslihan and Altay face to face. Having completed the first part of his mission, Korkut is now at Hamdi's house. Korkut takes his steps carefully and reports his condition at every moment. While the Neslihan's are after the stolen bag, the enemies are trying to find the code to open it. Altay will come face to face with danger as he aims to find out what happened to his brother.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Altay, who is trying to remove the bomb-laden vehicle, puts his life at risk. The purpose of the fall is to set a trap on one side while trying to kidnap the Machinist on the other. Neslihan, who involves everyone to prevent the kidnapping of the Machinist, tries to solve the emerging crisis. While Altay is in pursuit of a permit from the Machinist and thus his brother, the conflict between him and Neslihan continues. As Neslihan tries to recover the briefcase that represents the future of the country, Altay will come face to face with the enemy on his path to finding what he seeks. Hamdi's decision to distance himself from the dark world affects Korkut's operation. However, the attack planned against Hamdi will create new opportunities for Korkut.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Altay, who has seized the bag that everyone is after, is looking for an escape route. His goal now is to deliver the bag to the Neslihans. While the Neslihans are trying to find a trace of Altay, he is willing to put himself in danger once again to protect the bag at all costs. Upon finding Selen's message, Neslihan and her team realize the bag's importance once again. While Neslihan wants to retrieve the bag from the enemy, she also does everything she can to save Altay. With Hamdi’s move against the rivals, Korkut finds himself in danger. Although he feels uneasy knowing that his mission will also be at risk the moment things go wrong, he tries to remain calm.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: A phone call Altay receives turns his emotions upside down. Just as he was coming to terms with his brother's death, hearing Selen's voice rekindled his hope. At the invitation, Altay takes a risk and learns about the meeting plan. Thanks to him, Neslihan realizes what Düşman is after and urges the importance of the bag to be retrieved as soon as possible. Korkut's unexpected escape from Suat's trap shocks both Suat and the table. Hamdi appreciates Korkut once again. Despite the risk he faced, Korkut manages to continue the operation. Altay follows even the slightest clues to find Selen. This will bring him and Neslihan closer to both the bag and danger.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Due to the critical decision made by Neslihan to destroy the briefcase, Çanta ends up in the hands of the Makinist. Kate, who thinks she has reached victory, is left empty-handed. The teams can access half of the data in the briefcase with Altay's help. Güniz and Sedat, who are after Korkut's secret, bring Zeynep to Hamdi's house. Upon seeing Zeynep in front of him, Korkut realizes what Sedat is after. He must now act more cautiously to avoid being deciphered. To complete the data in the briefcase, Altay and Neslihan embark on a new path. Everything starts anew for them. As Altay goes into the field with Neslihan, the pain of losing his brother will challenge him once again.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Altay and Neslihan are shocked by what Turan, whom they knew as the Professor, said before he died. The real Professor is Turan's young son. The Machinist also hears this truth. To escape from the situation they have fallen into, Altay makes a dangerous move for both himself and Neslihan. When Korkut meets Akif, he realizes that he is being followed by Volkan. This situation poses a risk of exposure for both of them. Akif also understands that they are in a dead end. However, Korkut has a plan in mind. When Neslihan and Altay think their hopes are lost, they chase after the target again with the truth they have learned. Their goal is to find the real Professor before the Machinist and complete the important data for the state.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Neslihan and Altay receive the news that Kate has been caught. While Neslihan is pleased with the situation, Altay is on guard against potential moves. Although Kate is finally trapped, her allies do not abandon her, which justifies Altay's concern.Tufan presents Hamdi with an unexpected offer. While Hamdi keeps this situation a secret from Korkut, his response to Tufan is a matter of curiosity. Neslihan, with Altay's help, has reached the engineers. However, Kate's response will have shocking consequences for Altay.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Altay comes face to face with Berzan to take his revenge. However, Altay is unaware that his account with Berzan is not limited to the past. Selen, who is unconscious in Berzan's car, will turn all the truths upside down. Korkut manages to inform President Akif that the shipment is a trap, but he gets exposed. The opportunity Korkut has been seeking finally arrives. Even the enemy will willingly take him to the Queen he is searching for. The conflict between Altay and Neslihan continues with Altay's moves. With Kate bringing Selen, whom they thought was dead, to the forefront, Altay and Neslihan will find themselves on the brink of difficult decisions.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Altay, who is finally face to face with his sister whom he mourned, sees that Selen is the suicide bomber in Kate's treacherous plan. Neslihan is also aware that both they and the civilians around them are in great danger. Due to Suat's unexpected move, Korkut is on the brink of being exposed to both Hamdi and the table. He cannot afford for the operation to fail when he is so close to reaching the Queen. Having reunited with his sister, Altay will not lose Selen again, no matter the situation they find themselves in. Meanwhile, Neslihan will take great risks to save them.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Neslihan and Altay take a big risk in determining if their suspicions are correct. The moment they are attacked, they are sure that Selen is right. There is a traitor among them. Korkut's move dispelled Hamdi's doubts. However, to ensure his position, he challenged Hamdi. Although Korkut seems to have convinced Hamdi, those at the table will not let him go. Neslihan and the others conducted research to find Kate's agent in the organization. As a result of this research, the target will be someone very unexpected.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Korkut and Hamdi fall into Suat and Ağa's trap. Korkut's aim is to intimidate the enemies after he escapes from the trap he fell into. However, he must make moves that will not put the operation at risk. Uzay was shot the moment he realized that he was the target. Hayalet, who wants to make sure he is dead, does not let go of Uzay's pursuit. While Uzay tries to distract him with his intelligence, Altay will come to his aid. While Altay did not like Selen's surprise at all, Neslihan is also quite surprised by the new information she learns about Altay. While Altay comes face to face with his past that he has ignored, both he and Neslihan are not yet aware that this is more than a family matter. However, they will not bow to Kate and Tufan either in the field or in their personal relationships.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Neslihan and Altay are trapped by the Machinist together with İhsan Hoca. While the elevator is under the Machinist's control, Altay takes great risks to find a way of escape. Korkut does not give up on the trap set for him and Hamdi. He is determined to punish those behind it, but different challenges await him. Altay confronts his stepbrother Tufan, while Neslihan learns that İrfan Hoca knows Colonel Nazım. Although neither of them is aware, they will face their past. But no matter what, they will not allow the Queen to hinder them on this path.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: As a result of the exercise, the success of the project is proven. In the next phase, it is aimed to eliminate any issues. Altay is assigned to learn the enemy's next move. By the order of President Akif, Korkut is dismissed from his duty. Although President Akif thinks that Korkut is torn between his emotions and purpose, Korkut is confident in himself. A message that Korkut receives will completely change the course of events. As a result of the tortures inflicted on Professor İhsan, Kate has learned the content of the project. The enemies plan new attacks. Altay and Neslihan's goal is to thwart these plans. While Altay and Neslihan progress confidently in their mission, the Queen sets dangerous traps for them. But Altay will defeat them no matter what.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Selen, under the Queen's orders, has prevented Altay from accessing the computer. Altay is determined to catch whoever is hindering him from accessing the data, unaware of who the attacker is. Neslihan has complete trust in Altay. She is confident that he will succeed in his mission and bring back the stolen data to them. Even though President Akif gives the order to end the operation to Korkut, Korkut informs him of an unexpected development. Thanks to Levent, the Queen reaches out to Korkut and wants him and Hamdi to take a seat at the table. This situation will change both the balance of the table and the fate of the operation. Wanting to learn the Queen's target, Neslihan and Altay do everything they can to access the data and make a new plan. Their goal, as always, is to stay a few steps ahead of the enemy.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Korkut was about to announce the Queen's decision at the table when he received the news that Zeynep had been kidnapped. Korkut's sole objective is to rescue his sister without jeopardizing the operation. The return of Ejder will upset the balance. His presence will cast the shadow of darkness everywhere, revealing the true face of fear and chaos. Thanks to the plan they devised, Altay and Neslihan are very close to learning the identity of the Queen. Meanwhile, Selen is determined to prevent this and warn the Queen. Altay, who does not want to let the enemy slip away, puts himself at risk, while Neslihan is sure that he will succeed. Altay will not allow anyone to get hurt.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Altay and his father are subjected to a major attack. Tufan, who wants to reach the power he desires, has made a deal with Ejder to eliminate Ender. Ejder, who has joined the game, is confident that no one can stand in his way. Korkut loses the person he values most in this life. Blinded by the death of his brother, he seeks revenge. Korkut will hold everyone responsible for Zeynep's death accountable, one by one. Neslihan is worried because she cannot reach Altay. The enemies will once again realize that defeating Altay will never be easy.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Altay follows the clue he found, and Neslihan doesn't want to leave him alone. However, when Altay is incapacitated by a trap, he witnesses Neslihan being killed. Korkut learns that the person who ordered his sibling's death is Ejder. When Ejder comes to put Hamdi and those at the table in their place, he finds Korkut in front of him. This is the beginning of the war between them. While the Queen is trying to figure out Ejder, she is also pursuing the elimination of Altay, her greatest obstacle. Despite experiencing great pain, Altay will never bow down to the enemy.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: While Altay is chasing the capsules, he falls into the Queen's trap. Neslihan must make a difficult decision to protect the Protector. Altay, who does not know the reason for this decision, does not leave so many people to their fate. Ejder wants to intimidate Korkut. Korkut, who notices the bomb, must protect both himself and the people around him. However, the moves he will make while trying to defuse the bomb should not attract Hamdi's attention. Selen is beyond a terrible step under the manipulations of the Machinist and therefore the Queen. The move he will make may cost the lives of both his brother and the innocent people there. Altay, who will not bow down to the enemy, will do his best to save everyone from this trap.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Despite the Queen's efforts, Altay captures the Machinist. Now his main goal is to return to the country with him. Neslihan does everything she can to ensure Altay successfully completes this mission. While Korkut and Ejder are confronting each other, they face an unexpected visitor. Although this visit changes everything for them, Korkut is determined not to give up on avenging his brother's murderer. For Altay, bringing the Machinist back to the country will not be easy. While they are surrounded by enemies, the injured Machinist's condition is not good. Altay will take great risks to access important information through him, but he will not be alone on this path.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Altay, who does not allow Ejder to leave, faces Korkut. Korkut, on the other hand, has to make a big decision under the orders of Akif Başkan. Korkut, who needs to get Ejder out of there for the mission, shoots Altay. Although Korkut has saved Ejder, he is once again the target of suspicion. No matter what, Korkut, who has to cooperate with his greatest enemy for the sake of the operation, must not be exposed. Altay goes after Ejder, who escaped from his target. With the information he learned from the Machinist, the name of his enemy becomes clear to him. Altay and Neslihan, who want to reach the capsules, try to make the Machinist talk. On this path, Neslihan, who reaches important evidence, will face a devastating truth.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: After Altay learns that Ejder is behind everything, he is now after him. Korkut must stop Altay without revealing himself. To get closer to the Queen, Korkut must be willing to make some sacrifices. As situations become increasingly difficult, Ejder’s move will force Korkut to take great risks. Neslihan learns that the strands of hair in the Machinist's possession belong to Selen. She must be sure of her suspicions before telling this devastating truth to Altay. Altay and Neslihan obtain new clues about the Queen. A new danger awaits the duo who go to Monaco for the operation. Altay will once again face the fear of losing Neslihan.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Altay is devastated by the shocking truth he has uncovered. He cannot bring himself to accept that his beloved sister, Selen, is a traitor. Meanwhile, Neslihan, unable to reach him, senses that something is seriously wrong. Following an attack on President Akif, Korkut is forced to step in and protect him. However, he remains unaware that Hamdi is watching everything from a distance. Akif shares his suspicions about the true motive behind the attack with Korkut, setting the stage for a major confrontation in Korkut’s life. As Neslihan and her team continue tracking Selen, Altay struggles to hide his emotions from her. The weight of betrayal fuels his anger, making it increasingly difficult to contain himself. While Neslihan tries to calm him down, Altay is on the verge of making irreversible decisions—ones that may change everything forever.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: As Altay confronts Selen, he finds himself facing a grave danger. Meanwhile, Neslihan is forced to shoot Selen in order to stop her. Korkut, determined to reach the Queen, sets his sights on discrediting Ejder as his next target, with Hamdi by his side to execute the plan. Fearing exposure, Kate relentlessly pursues Selen. However, Altay and Neslihan recognize that Selen could be their key to uncovering the true identity of the Queen. Yet, the biggest obstacle ahead isn’t just Selen’s gunshot wound—it’s something far more formidable. Their search for answers leads them down an unexpected path, bringing them face to face with a shocking figure.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: As Neslihan rushes to deliver the antidote to Selen, the Queen’s men launch an attack on the clinic. Risking her own life to save Selen, Neslihan puts herself in grave danger, while Altay is willing to sacrifice everything to protect her. Following orders from Akif Başkan, Korkut sets out to track down the Queen, the mastermind behind Sofia’s murder. Cornered and desperate to remain unidentified, the Queen does everything in her power to stay hidden—but Korkut is closer than ever to confronting her. Meanwhile, thanks to Altay, the Organization uncovers the Queen’s latest schemes and is determined to dismantle them. Neslihan and Altay, standing by their decision, refuse to bow down to the Queen or her allies, no matter the cost.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Altay and Neslihan stand their ground against their enemies with a bold decision, but this choice also puts their lives in danger. Meanwhile, Korkut finally comes face-to-face with the Queen through his carefully crafted plan. However, Kate is far from pleased with this encounter and remains deeply distrustful of Korkut. Despite Akif Başkan’s warnings, Hamdi acts alone and falls into Ejder’s trap. Seizing the opportunity, Ejder plans to use Hamdi against Korkut. As Altay and Neslihan work to prevent uranium from being used against their country, they edge closer to the Queen. The clues left behind will be their key to uncovering the truth.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Altay finally learns that the Queen is actually Kate. While he grapples with this shocking truth, Korkut’s life is also in grave danger. Altay and Neslihan, shaken by the revelation, quickly realize they must focus on helping Korkut. Kate, unsure of Korkut’s loyalty, begins to see him as a threat. In an effort to earn the Queen’s trust, Korkut is prepared to take a huge risk. Meanwhile, Kurtbey and Fırtına will finally come face to face. As they join forces to crush the enemy from two fronts, this powerful alliance is set to shift all the balances.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: As the enemies are defeated one by one, new dangers continue to rise from the darkness. The Organization, which has consistently foiled treacherous plans, is now on the brink of a war greater than ever. With Eylül and Buğra joining the team, President Cevher's inauguration adds strength to their forces. This unity further intensifies the fight to uncover the enemy's true purpose, while Korkut is forced to confront the traces of his past on his own journey. As Altay takes action against the traps set by the traitors, he faces a name that will shift the balance of power: Rutkay's right-hand woman, Hilal. The shocking encounter between Altay and Hilal becomes his greatest test. As always, one step ahead of his enemies, the Organization is ready for any challenge it will face. But this time, the battle isn't just on the field; it's in the hearts of those who are.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Cevher President’s decision about Altay and Hilal takes the two by surprise. When Hilal opposes the decision, she faces Cevher President’s harsh reaction. While she is caught in a major dilemma, Altay does everything he can to remind her of the importance of their mission. Although Korkut’s plan to use Ejder is risky, he takes the gamble with Cevher President’s approval. Meanwhile, in her moment of desperation, Bahar once again turns to  Korkut. As he helps her, Korkut remains cautious about her past. Altay, on one hand, tries to eliminate the Dizdar threat, and on the other, prepares for a larger plan. This plan will lead to an important encounter—and the balance of power will shift.

videos.title: Episode 171
videos.overview: Altay and Hilal are caught in the heart of the conflict, while Davut, having escaped, races to reach the donor heart. Just as he believes everything is going smoothly, a major setback from Altay upends his plans. Shaken by Hamdi’s betrayal, Korkut is nearly destroyed. The team carries the weight of their sorrow, while Hamdi has already determined his own punishment. Meanwhile, Korkut relentlessly pursues Hayat, willing to risk everything to catch her. Rutkay continues to play both sides between Davut and Altay. As overlooked details begin surfacing one by one, he is close to seeing the full picture. Altay’s team, however, is prepared for the enemy’s manipulations and ready to counter their schemes.

videos.title: Episode 172
videos.overview: Korkut has captured Hayat with his major move alongside Altay and Hilal. The team once again makes both Cevher and the Organization proud. Rutkay is stunned by the major truth he has learned. After confronting Altay and Hilal, he prepares to set his treacherous plan into motion. While Korkut eliminates the uncertainties between him and his loved ones, he also sets out after Davut. Hilal reunites with her long-lost brother, but this joy does not last long. Altay will fight to ensure Hilal does not endure the pains he has suffered.

videos.title: Episode 173
videos.overview: While Hilal is devastated by the Güneş's death, everyone is deeply affected. Altay swears revenge in front of the entire team. Korkut tries to unravel the mysterious man who came to his aid. This mysterious man will change all the balances. Ejder, having lost Suzan, steels himself. For him, too, life no longer holds any meaning. The only thing he aims for is to kill Rutkay. Davut, whom the Organization has been pursuing for a long time, unexpectedly surrenders of his own accord. The team realizes there's a major scheme behind this surrender. To prevent the terrorist attack planned by Davut, Altay springs into action immediately. Just minutes before the attack, Altay's communication with headquarters is cut off. This forces Cevher into making a critical decision.

videos.title: Episode 174
videos.overview: After Altay thwarts the enemy's major terror plan, the Organization springs into action to dismantle the remaining forces of the Company. The team devises a clever and risky plan to achieve their goal. Korkut is assigned a cross-border mission to combat the Company's other structures. The duration of the mission is indefinite. But this time, for Korkut, the real challenge isn't the mission itself, but what he'll be leaving behind. Because now there's Bahar. While Rutkay is making escape plans, Julia doesn't let go of her suspicions. She claims that the person said to have been killed in the Organization's operation is not his father. While Altay and the team are in the midst of a major operation, it will be revealed that the real enemy is much closer than they thought.

videos.title: Episode 175
videos.overview: Altay and Hilal are on the verge of uncovering Davut's secret. Davut, however, will play all his cards to prevent his grand scheme from unraveling. Korkut has succeeded and earned the right to meet with the Sultan. While danger continues to lurk for him, a major surprise that comes their way will shock Korkut and Hamdi. Teşkilat is pursuing vital information using Doruk. As the enemy sets traps, the team mobilizes for the operation. Major confrontations await Altay that will turn everything upside down.
